short_description.text: Elimelech — husband of Naomi (RUT 1:2). Of the tribe of Judah.
Naomi — wife of Elimelech (RUT 1:2) and mother-in-law of Ruth (RUT 1:4).
Mahlon — son of Elimelech (RUT 1:2) and husband of Ruth (RUT 4:10). Of the tribe of Judah.
Chilion — son of Elimelech (RUT 1:2). Of the tribe of Judah.
Orpah — wife of Chilion (RUT 1:4) [process of elimination based on RUT 4:10].
Boaz — kinsman of Naomi's husband (RUT 2:1) who redeemed Ruth (RUT 4:10). Of the tribe of Judah.
Obed — son of Ruth and father of Jesse (RUT 4:17). Of the tribe of Judah.
Jesse — father of David (RUT 4:17). Of the tribe of Judah.
David — son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3). Of the tribe of Judah.
Ram — son of Hezron in the lineage of King David (RUT 4:19). Of the tribe of Judah.
Salmon — son of Nahshon and father of Boaz in the lineage of King David (RUT 4:19). Of the tribe of Judah.
